description: Sign-in required: call connect(email) and connect_verify first (free, one email) unless this connection is already signed in. The document's text exactly as the publisher published it (šaltinio tekstas), paged by character offset, with none of our sections, voice labels or units: the source our structure is built on. Read it to check us when a read's `structure_check` says `verify`, when a section or speaker label looks wrong, or before you rely on whose words a passage is. Each page gives the publisher's link, the text's sha256, how the text is held (`raw_basis`) and the units of ours it overlaps (`units_here`), so you can cross-check our structure. Continue with `next_from_char`. If our structure is wrong, say so: submit_feedback(kind='structure'). ECHR cases (`coe.hudoc:`) have no text here: the answer says so and gives the HUDOC link. Example arguments: {"document_id": "<document_id or unit id from a result>", "from_char": 0, "max_chars": 6000}.

document_id.description: What to read, as in read_paragraphs: a search hit's `id` (a `#` unit id starts the page where that unit starts), a `document.id`, a case number or an act's number.
document_id.title: Document Id

from_char.description: Character offset to start at, 0 for the top; continue with the previous page's `next_from_char`. A read's `structure_check.raw.args` gives the offsets of the span it served.
from_char.title: From Char

jurisdiction.description: Which jurisdiction the id belongs to (`LT`). Omit for the account's own.
jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction

max_chars.description: Page size in characters, default 6000, at most 20000. A page ends at a line break or space, never inside a word.
max_chars.title: Max Chars

on_date.description: On an act: `YYYY-MM-DD` reads the held edition in force that day (its own text, link and dates). Omit for the current text. Rulings have one text.
on_date.title: On Date

session.description: The `session` value the sign-in returned. Pass it on every call in this conversation, so the sign-in survives however this client handles connections; omit it when the user connected with Sign in (OAuth) or a key.

name: read_source_text
title: The publisher's text, as published
